### Notes

The target URL https://www.databricks.com/startups returns 404; the live program page is https://www.databricks.com/product/startups. That page publishes the credit figure but NO eligibility criteria at all — no age, funding, VC-backing, employee or regional rule — and instead says "Not sure if you qualify? Apply or ask your investor". The stages listed here come from Databricks' own announcement post https://www.databricks.com/blog/announcing-new-databricks-startup-program (16 June 2026), which describes "Early-stage, venture-backed startups" that "recently raised institutional funding (pre-seed through Series A)". Because that wording is on the blog and not on the program page, requires_vc_backing and funding_required are left unknown rather than set true. Credit duration and any expiry are published nowhere I could find. The apply button points to a Google Sites form (sites.google.com/databricks.com/startup-program-apply) carrying itm_ tracking parameters, so apply_url is set to the clean program page instead. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
